cues.en: I'll take care of the check.
cues.zh: 我来付账单。

cues.en: You guys can get the tip.
cues.zh: 你们可以给小费。

cues.en: Should be about a buck apiece.
cues.zh: 每人差不多一块钱。

cues.en: And you, when I come back, I want my book.
cues.zh: 还有你，我回来时要拿到我的书。

cues.en: Sorry. It's my book now.
cues.zh: 抱歉，现在这书归我了。

cues.en: Hey. I changed my mind.
cues.zh: 嘿，我改变主意了。

cues.en: Shoot this piece of shit with me.
cues.zh: 跟我一起把这破玩意儿打了。

cues.en: Alright.
cues.zh: 好吧。

cues.en: Everybody cough up some green food, little lady.
cues.zh: 大家都掏点绿票子出来，小姑娘。

cues.en: Come on, throw in a bug.
cues.zh: 来，多少也给点小费。

cues.en: Uh-uh, don't tip. You don't tip?
cues.zh: 不，不用给小费。你不给吗？

cues.en: No, I don't believe in it.
cues.zh: 不给，我不认同小费这套。

cues.en: You don't believe in tipping?
cues.zh: 你不认同给小费？

cues.en: Do you know what these chicks make? They make shit.
cues.zh: 你知道这些姑娘挣多少钱吗？少得可怜。

cues.en: Don't give me that. She don't make enough money. She can quit.
cues.zh: 少跟我来这套。嫌赚得少，她可以辞职啊。

cues.en: I don't even know a fucking Jew would have to bother to say that. Let me just get this straight. You don't ever tip,
cues.zh: 我都没见过哪个抠门鬼会好意思说这种话。等会儿，我先确认一下，你从来都不给小费？

cues.en: I don't tip because society says I have to. All right, I mean, I'll tip if somebody really deserves a tip. If they really put forth the effort, I'll give them something extra. But, I mean, this tipping automatically,
cues.zh: 我可不会因为社会规矩说该给我就给。行吧，我的意思是，如果有人真配得上，我会给的。要是他们真的很卖力，我会多给点。但是，我是说，这种无脑给小费的规矩，

cues.en: is for the birds.
cues.zh: 纯粹是扯淡。

cues.en: I mean, as far as I'm concerned, they're just doing their job. Hey, this girl was nice. She was okay. I mean, she wasn't anything special. What's special? Take you in the back and suck your dick?
cues.zh: 在我看来，她们不过是做好本职工作罢了。嘿，这姑娘人不错，还可以，我是说，她也没什么特别的。什么算特别？把你带到后面给你口交吗？

cues.en: I'd go over 12% for that. Look, I ordered coffee. Right? Now, we've been here a long fucking time. She's only filled my cup three times. I mean, when I order coffee, I want it filled six times.
cues.zh: 那样的话，我宁愿多给12%的小费。你看，我点了咖啡对吧？我们都在这儿坐了他妈好久了。她才给我续了三次杯。我是说，我点咖啡的时候，希望它能续上六次。

cues.en: Six times? Well, you know, worse, he's too fucking busy. Words too fucking busy shouldn't be in a waitress's vocabulary.
cues.zh: 六次？嗯，你知道，更糟的是，他妈的太忙了。“他妈的太忙了”这种话不该出现在服务员的字典里。

cues.en: Excuse me, mister Pink, but the last fucking thing you need is another cup of coffee. Jesus Christ, I mean, these ladies aren't starving to death. They make minimum wage.
cues.zh: 不好意思，Pink先生，你现在最不需要的就是再来一杯咖啡。我的天，这些姑娘又没饿得要死。她们拿的是最低工资。

cues.en: You know, I used to work minimum wage, and when I did, I wasn't lucky enough to have a job the society deemed tip worthy. You don't care if they'd count on your tips to live?
cues.zh: 我以前也拿过最低工资，可那时候没你们这么幸运，社会觉得你们这份工作值得给小费。你就不在乎她们是不是靠小费过活吗？

cues.en: You know what this is?
cues.zh: 知道这是什么吗？

cues.en: It's the world's smallest violin playing just for the waitresses.
cues.zh: 这是世界上最小的小提琴，专门拉给女服务员听的。

cues.en: You don't have any idea what you're talking about.
cues.zh: 你根本不知道自己在说什么。

cues.en: These people bust their ass.
cues.zh: 这些人拼死拼活地干活。

cues.en: This is a hard job.
cues.zh: 这工作可不容易。

cues.en: So is working at McDonald's, but you don't feel the need to tip them, do you? Why not? They're serving you food. But no, society says, don't tip these guys over here, but tip these guys over here. That's bullshit. Wait, Christine, it's the number one occupation for female non college graduates in this country.
cues.zh: 在麦当劳打工也一样不容易，但你觉得有必要给他们小费吗？没有吧？为什么不给？他们也是在给你端吃的。但社会却规定，别给这帮人小费，得给那帮人小费。简直扯淡。等等，Christine，这可是这个国家非大学学历女性的首选职业。

cues.en: It's the one job basically any woman can get and make a living on.
cues.zh: 这几乎是任何女人都能得到并赖以谋生的唯一工作。

cues.en: The reason is because of their tips.
cues.zh: 原因就在于她们的小费。

cues.en: Fuck all that.
cues.zh: 去他妈的吧。

cues.en: Jesus Christ. I mean, I'm very sorry the government taxes their tips. That's fucked up. That ain't my fault.
cues.zh: 我的天。我是说，政府向她们的小费征税，我非常抱歉。这太操蛋了。但那不是我的错。

cues.en: I mean, it would appear that waitresses are one of the many groups the government fucks in the ass on a regular basis. I mean, if you you show me a piece of paper that says the government shouldn't do that, I'll sign it. Put it to a vote, I'll vote for it. But what I won't do is play ball. And it's non college bullshit you've given me. I got two words for that. Learn to fucking type. Because if you're expecting me to help out with the rent, you're in for a big fucking surprise.
cues.zh: 我是说，看来女服务员是政府定期操弄的众多群体之一。我是说，你要是给我一份文件，写明政府不该那么做，我就签字。付诸投票，我就投赞成。但我不干的事是配合。你给我的净是些没上过大学的狗屁。对此我就两个字：学着去他妈打字吧。因为你要是指望我帮忙付房租，那你就等着大吃一惊吧。

cues.en: Just convince me. Give me my dollar back. Hey.
cues.zh: 说服我就行。把我的一美元还给我。嘿。

cues.en: Leave the dollars there.
cues.zh: 把那些钱留在那儿。

cues.en: Alright, ramblers. Let's get rambling.
cues.zh: 好了，各位闲聊家，开始闲聊吧。

cues.en: Wait a minute.
cues.zh: 等一下。

cues.en: Who did throw in? Mister Pink. Mister Pink.
cues.zh: 谁投了钱？Mister Pink。Mister Pink。

cues.en: Why not? You don't tip.
cues.zh: 为什么不投？你又不给小费。

cues.en: You don't tip?
cues.zh: 你不给小费？

cues.en: What do you mean you don't tip? You don't believe in it. Shut up.
cues.zh: 你说你不给小费是什么意思？你觉得这不该给。闭嘴。

cues.en: What do you mean you don't believe in it? Come on, you. Cough off a bucket, cheap bastard. I paid for your goddamn breakfast. Alright. Since you pay for the breakfast, I'll put in. But normally, I would never do this.
cues.zh: 你说你觉得这不该给是什么意思？来吧，你这家伙。咳一桶出来吧，小气鬼。我可是付了你那该死的早餐钱。行吧，既然早餐是你付的，我就投点钱。不过平时我绝不会这么做。

cues.en: Never mind what you normally would do. Just cough in your goddamn buck like everybody else.
cues.zh: 别管你平时怎么做，跟其他人一样把钱乖乖掏出来就行了。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢。
